common: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE production-quality horizontal desktop WEBSITE SECTION concept for PNPLINE, a Chinese-facing cross-border logistics company. NOT a slide, not an illustration alone, not a whole multi-section website, no browser chrome, no mockup laptop. Canvas MUST be 1920 px wide, with all UI/text/essential content aligned inside centered 1440 px content width (left x=240, right x=1680, outer margins 240). Full-bleed backgrounds may extend to edges. Render at 1920 wide if supported, otherwise same aspect and proportions. Palette fixed across set: cyan #00ABE1, action teal #007FA8, deep maritime navy #122C3D, warm white #F5F6F2, gray #76838A. Crisp Simplified Chinese modern rational sans (Noto Sans SC mood), headline 60-72px, labels 24-28px, small text >=18px at1920. Spacious clear hierarchy, short copy, restrained 4px radius rectangular buttons and hairline rules. Brand is exact supplied PNPLINE logo; do not redesign it or invent logos. Physical high-end 1:87-scale miniature logistics diorama visuals: detailed painted diecast trucks, corrugated cyan containers, cardboard cartons, small forklift workers, maritime/navy warehouses, tactile concrete, selective tilt-shift shallow DOF, cinematic highlight rolloff and restrained film grain. Clearly miniature NOT life-size photography, flat isometric vector, clay blobs or futuristic illustration. Continuous cyan route conveys one shipment. Diagrams/icons must carry information, no fake stats/prices, endorsements, certification badges, fictional contact details, extra filler text. One consistent brand world with varied editorial compositions. Text must be accurate Simplified Chinese as quoted. This is a CONCEPT, not documentary facility evidence. No output labels, external captions or layout measurement annotations inside artwork.
